attributes.action: We call on the Government and the Gambling Commission to review the Lottery
attributes.additional_details:
We call on the Government and the Gambling Commission to review recent National Lottery game changes that have split prize funds across multiple draws while significantly reducing many lower-tier prizes.
Many players believe these changes have reduced value for money despite ticket prices remaining unchanged. We ask for a transparent review of the impact on players and for consideration of restoring a fairer prize structure with impoved jackpots by reverting back to 49 numbers not 59
